The vertebrate mitochondrial spectrum implies an equilibrium amino-acid composition and an expected substitution matrix. Gene strand across phyla is summarized from RefSeq mtDNA.

```{=html}
<iframe src="interactive/expected_aa.html" title="Expected amino-acid rates" style="width:100%;height:640px;border:0;"></iframe>
```

Hover a cell for the amino-acid pair and its expected rate. Diagonal identities are omitted. The matrix is the saved file `analyses/01_equilibrium/data/exp_aa_subst_vert.csv`.
